purpose: ring-neuron dopamine stage 2: isolate the dopamine field from CX_DAN's fast synapses, then ask whether fumin differs from wild type

reachability.euler_note: 1 ms explicit Euler of the same pool balance used by Neuromod.on_chunk, 20 s from the 0.02 uM baseline

fumin_reachability.note: closed form of the item-129 pool balance with the committed alpha_c and S_c; wild type keeps Vmax, fumin sets it to zero. The measured run values are separate.

probe.purpose: ring-neuron dopamine stage 2: per-cell measurement of the ER response with the dopamine field driven and CX_DAN fast synapses retained or disconnected; wild type versus fumin. A null here is a real null.

protocol.source_event_definition: sum over a source population's spike counts times its effective substrate weight times the live postsynaptic gain in the measurement window
protocol.disconnect_definition: Neuromod.apply_genotype with dan_fast_synapses='disconnect' zeroes every recurrent synapse whose presynaptic cell is in DAN or CX_DAN; it does not silence those cells, change their extended input rates, or change the innervation matrix or kinetics

key_field_isolated_spikes.unit: per seed, (driven-disconnect minus dark) divided by (driven-retain minus dark) over the same ten seeds; the interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE and the ratio is undefined in sign if the denominator straddles zero, so the absolute spike counts are reported beside it

retain_minus_dark.unit: paired difference is left minus right over the ten seeds; interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE

disconnect_minus_dark.unit: paired difference is left minus right over the ten seeds; interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE

retain_minus_disconnect.unit: paired difference is left minus right over the ten seeds; interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE

fumin_retain_minus_wild_type_retain.unit: paired difference is left minus right over the ten seeds; interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE

fumin_disconnect_minus_wild_type_disconn.unit: paired difference is left minus right over the ten seeds; interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE

limitation: The disconnection removes the fast route only for the arms that declare it. It zeroes every recurrent synapse whose presynaptic cell is in DAN or CX_DAN; it does not silence those cells, change their extended input, the innervation matrix or the kinetics. The dopamine field is not identical in a retain/disconnect pair: the audit leaves the pool kinetics intact, but the per-seed EB concentrations measure a small difference (wild-type retain 3.4786 uM against disconnect 3.4303 uM, paired +0.0483 uM [+0.00647, +0.09014] excluding zero). The audit verifies the weights, the index arrays and the EB innervation row are unchanged, not that the field is identical. The probe still injects at TuBu, downstream of a visual pathway that does not conduct: the fly does not see.
reading_note: The ring threshold term d_v is non-monotonic in dopamine (item 135): it peaks at 0.16219 uM and crosses zero at 1.85000 uM. A genotype difference is read only beside the measured EB concentration of each arm and the side of the crossover it sits on. Every interval that includes zero is reported as including zero; no pass floor or threshold is applied. Per-cell values are never collapsed into a population mean to stand in for a directly reached subset. 'responder'/'responders' means a cell that fires at least one spike in the window (active), not a demonstrated stripe-selective cell; the TuBu stripe is on in every arm. Every interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE on ten paired seeds; the paired-t multiplier at n=10 is 2.262, so the intervals are narrower than a 95 percent t interval.
linearity_note: The +1465.7 field term and the +84.7 fast term are a decomposition only if the two routes add linearly, which this design does not establish. The design crossed fast edges present/absent with the dopamine field dynamic and ran three of four cells; the missing cell is fast edges retained with the ER dopamine modulation clamped to its vehicle trajectory. Removing fast excitation can leave ER cells further below threshold, so the same dopamine buys fewer spikes. Report the result as the fraction of stage 1's effect that survives removal of the fast synapses (0.9465, the mean of the ten per-seed disconnect/retain ratios; the ratio of the paired means is 0.94537), a lower bound on the field's contribution under this design, not a partition.
field_mismatch_note: The retain and disconnect arms are not matched on the field: retain sits at 3.4786 uM EB against disconnect 3.4303 uM (paired +0.0483 uM, excluding zero). Both are past item 135's 1.85 uM crossover on the descending branch, so the higher retain field lowers the retain threshold and the field difference works in the same direction as the fast route. The +84.7 retain-minus-disconnect difference is therefore an upper bound on the fast route.
input_note: The TuBu source-rate intervals include zero. That is no detected mean-rate difference, not equivalence. A pooled mean rate can hide a changed effective input: spike timing and connection-weighted rate are not the same as mean rate. The connection-weighted TuBu-to-ER event amplitude from the raw files gives retain-minus-disconnect -2131 mV [-7464, +3202] (includes zero), so no effective-input difference is detected in that contrast either.
control_note: The disconnect layer zeroes all 70,134 DAN+CX_DAN outgoing edges, not only the 212 CX_DAN-to-ER edges: 7,919 are CX_DAN and 62,215 are from other DAN, and 213 reach a traced ER cell. The dark arm retains those edges. The dark arm's CX_DAN cells are silent (0 to 1 spike per seed), but the raw files record no non-CX_DAN DAN spike count; the committed t-0024 census measured DAN firing at about 0.89 Hz in its spontaneous arms. If any removed DAN edge is active in the dark arm, the disconnect arm also loses that dark input, which makes +1465.7 conservative rather than inflated. The magnitude is unmeasured in this round.

disconnect_audit.purpose: verify the dan_fast_synapses disconnect layer removes only DAN/CX_DAN fast synapses

provenance_note.note: The probe ran under the executed runner whose SHA-256 is recorded in identity. The committed runner differs only in the summarize function, where a KeyError was fixed to read the raw per-seed runs instead of the aggregated paired rows; the engine, probe and per-cell arithmetic are unchanged. identity.runner_sha256 is the honest run-time binding; summarizing_runner_sha256 is the file that produced this record.
